reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what get me, plus the empty-box refund so I'm not stuck. At $24.99 I'd try one box on a late-night scroll, but not two.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And it's made in China, so I'm relying on that lab report being real.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing the lab report for a real batch, or a price over $30 for the first box would flip me to no.
